# QScrape

> A scraper playground by Cascading Labs. Site first, version second. All products and orders are synthetic.

## eShop

- [Choose a version](/eshop/)
- [HTML eShop](/eshop/html/): Products and product details appear in the HTML response. JavaScript is unnecessary for core extraction.
- [JavaScript eShop](/eshop/javascript/): Products render in the browser after a loading state.
- [Protected eShop](/eshop/protected/): Delayed hydration, Shadow DOM catalogue content, and a hidden decoy exercise extraction behavior. This is not live provider-backed protection.
- [Expected catalogue](/eshop/fixtures.json): Ground-truth synthetic product data for comparing extraction results.

All three versions share the same six products and support a sample cart stored locally in the browser. No real purchases take place.
